desc: Round 10 overview: what changed in v0.10 (chat in two panes, documents beside the conversation), the four review flows and every state.
Public page at /: what Smart Tutor does, how it works, trust points, “Create an account” and “Sign in”. Text only, outside the app shell.
Keycloak registration page: stock keycloak.v2 layout, email as username (no Username field), with the Smart Tutor logo, colours, font and name (low-detail reference).
Keycloak email-verification page: stock keycloak.v2 layout (low-detail reference).
Keycloak login page: stock keycloak.v2 layout (low-detail reference).
Navigation collapsed to the 56px icon rail; names show as tooltips on hover and focus (here: Chat). The choice is remembered.
Live Library: the home screen, with the sample documents; the upload-rights line sits under “Upload” (where navigation lands).
Empty, first run: “Upload your first document”, with “Only upload documents you have the right to use.” under it.
Files dragged over the page: the whole page accepts the drop; the upload-rights line shows in the drop target.
Three PDFs uploading, each with a progress bar in the tray.
Processing: titles appear first; no “Choose subjects” until processing finishes.
Processing finished: highlighted rows, “Choose subjects”, and the toolbar chip “3 need subjects” (no banner, M10).
All three documents ready; “Ask a question” leads to the first answer.
Needs action: Toolformer needs subjects; banner and Library badge.
Rejected before upload: not a PDF, or over 50 MB.
Already in your library: a link to the document, or Restore if archived.
Failed: the scanned PDF has no text layer, with Retry; after 3 attempts, no Retry.
After Retry: the document is processing again (attempt 2 of 3).
Archived tab: Restore, what archiving means for answers; no “Change subjects” on archived rows or in their More menu (E7).
After archiving ReAct (J4): find it under Archived.
No results: “No documents match these filters” and Clear filters.
Filtered by subject (matches any of a document's subjects).
“More” menu of a ready row: Details, Change subjects, Edit title, Archive, Delete (K4); ready rows show “Chat” and the title opens the viewer (P7). A processing row offers no Delete.
Delete confirmation: Cancel focused, Delete in danger style, “Archive instead” under the warning. The same dialog opens from details.
Deleted: the row is gone and “Chain-of-Thought Prompting… deleted.” confirms it. No undo.
Upload limit reached: hourly “You can upload again at 11:40 (GMT+7)”, daily “You can upload again at 00:00 (GMT+7)”; Upload disabled.
Toolformer: summary, 3 suggestions with origin, first pre-selected.
Type-ahead searches the shared catalog; existing subjects come first.
Near-duplicate: “We'll use the existing subject Large Language Models.”
Rejected name: “Please choose a different name.” with the reason.
Over 60 characters: blocked, with a counter.
Nothing selected: Save is disabled.
Three selected: the other chips and the type-ahead are disabled.
Saved: “Subjects saved. Toolformer… is ready to use.” The document is Ready right away.
Several documents waiting: step through them (“1 of 3”, Next, Skip).
Change subjects of a ready document (J4).
Ready document: facts, summary, subjects; Open (viewer), Ask about this, Archive and Delete. No download.
Editing the display title, with “Reset to extracted title”.
Processing a 424-page book: up to 15 minutes; no Open and no Delete while processing.
Failed: “No text layer (scanned PDFs are not supported yet)”, with Retry.
Archived document (J4): Restore, Open read-only and Delete; no “Change subjects” until it is restored (E7).
New conversation: placeholder and optional example questions; no subjects (K1). Where navigation lands.
New conversation started from ReAct… (“Ask about this”): listed in the panel as added, composer focused, “Only search these documents” off.
No documents yet: chat is replaced by “Upload a document first”.
Documents still processing: a quiet hint above the input.
Streaming answer with Stop.
Answers with citations; the follow-up is answered from another document (one archived, “Archived”). No subject chips; citations open the viewer.
Citations switched off: the same thread, answers unchanged.
“Not helpful” is pressed and opens an optional reason; “Helpful” pressed on the first answer.
Conversation panel, Documents used (3): ReAct, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and PPO, in order of first use; one click opens a document beside the conversation.
Conversation panel before the first answer: “Documents used to answer will appear here.”
Add documents: the picker with search, the learner's ready documents, listed ones checked and disabled, one selected, “Add”.
“Only search these documents” on: three documents listed and “Searching 3 documents · Change” above the composer.
A decline with the switch on: “These documents don't cover this.” with “Add documents” and “Search all my documents”.
Editing the conversation title inline: the field is open with the title selected (Enter or clicking away saves, Esc cancels, 1–120 characters).
Conversation panel collapsed with the header toggle: the conversation takes the full width (the choice is remembered).
Conversation panel: a deleted document stays listed as “Deleted”, can't be opened; “Deleted documents can't be opened.”
A citation to a deleted document reads “Deleted document”, with no link.
Decline: a document on the topic is needed to continue; “Upload a document” is the only action. Adds nothing to Documents used.
No active documents: all documents archived; history stays readable and a new question gets “Upload”.
“Summarize lesson” in progress.
Note saved: confirmation in the conversation; the panel's Lesson Note links the note.
A note exists and wasn't edited: the panel offers “Open note” and “Update lesson note”, which replaces it directly.
The note was edited: “You've edited this note. Replace it with a new summary?”
Archived conversation: banner with Restore, input disabled.
Rate limited: per minute “You can send again at 11:25 (GMT+7)”, daily “You can send again at 00:00 (GMT+7)”; input disabled until then.
The answer failed: Retry.
Started from a note: “Started from note: title” at the top.
J1 ends here: the first cited answer from freshly uploaded papers; no subjects to choose.
Split view from the panel: ReAct… opens beside the conversation at page 1, no highlight; panel collapsed, nav on its rail.
Split view from the chip “ReAct · p. 3”: page 3 beside the conversation, passage highlighted, the chip stays highlighted.
Split view: the cited page with “Couldn't highlight the passage on this page.” inside the pane.
Outside chat the viewer stays the overlay: an archived document opened from the Library (details → Open), read-only with “Archived” and “Restore”.
Open in dialog from the pane: the same document, page 3 and highlight in the large overlay, with a details strip (authors, year, pages, subjects); Close returns to the split view.
Split view loading: page skeleton inside the pane while the cited page loads first.
Split view error: “We couldn't open this document.” with Retry inside the pane.
Live list: subject chips of the documents used, number of documents used, last activity, note indicator.
Archived tab with Restore.
Subject filter matches any subject of a conversation's documents used; Chain-of-Thought Prompting… is deleted, so its subjects no longer count (L1).
No results for these filters.
No conversations yet, with “Start a conversation”.
Opened from the list: history plus its Lesson Note linked in the header.
Live list: subjects, date, source conversation, “Edited” marker.
Archived notes with Restore.
No lesson notes yet.
Generated note: Markdown and preview, Discuss this note, source link.
Edited note: the “Edited” marker that triggers the overwrite confirmation.
Unsaved changes; Save enabled.
Archived note: read-only with Restore.
My subjects with counts; LLMs shows its shared name and Reset name.
Renaming inline: “Only you see this name.”
Rename clashes with another of the learner's own subject names (a shared name she doesn't have is allowed, D6).
Same naming checks as the picker: personal information is rejected.
Today (the GMT+7 day) and all time; Conversations, Document processing, Background.
Subject selector, timeline by year, citation links, works without a year.
Work details: files, cites and cited-by within the library.
Numbered reading order with a reason for each step.
“How did idea develop?” opens a chat answer that walks the works in order.
Sparse subject: explains what is missing.
Select 1–10 active notes and generate a quiz.
Quiz generation progress (up to ~15 s).
Multiple-choice questions, 4 options.
Score, explanations, score per topic, retake, flag.
Same list pattern for quizzes.
Daily / weekly reports with Generate now.
Report: topics, conversations, quiz results, weak topics, recommendations.
“What should I learn next?” cards with Start learning.
Every reusable component, in both themes.
Brief v0.4 decisions (Q7, D1–D8) and new questions.
